window-inline-and-named.sql: SELECT "r"."id", SUM("r"."weight") OVER ( PARTITION BY "r"."kind" ORDER BY "r"."at" ASC ) AS "running", row_number() OVER "by_kind" AS "n", AVG("r"."weight") OVER (  ) FROM "reading" AS "r" WINDOW "by_kind" AS ( PARTITION BY "r"."kind" )

window-frames.sql: SELECT SUM("w") OVER (  ORDER BY "r"."id" ASC ROWS BETWEEN $1 PRECEDING AND $2 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW ), SUM("w") OVER (  ORDER BY "r"."id" ASC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING ), SUM("w") OVER (  ORDER BY "r"."id" ASC GROUPS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING ), SUM("w") OVER (  ORDER BY "r"."id" ASC RANGE BETWEEN CAST($3::text AS interval) PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ), SUM("w") OVER (  ORDER BY "r"."id" ASC ROWS BETWEEN $4 FOLLOWING AND $5 FOLLOWING ), SUM("w") OVER (  ORDER BY "r"."id" ASC ROWS BETWEEN $6 PRECEDING AND $7 PRECEDING ), SUM("w") OVER (  ORDER BY "r"."id" ASC ROWS CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE TIES ), SUM("w") OVER (  ORDER BY "r"."id" ASC GROUPS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE NO OTHERS ) FROM "reading" AS "r"

window-functions.sql: SELECT rank() OVER (  ORDER BY "id" ASC ), dense_rank() OVER (  ORDER BY "id" ASC ), percent_rank() OVER (  ORDER BY "id" ASC ), cume_dist() OVER (  ORDER BY "id" ASC ), ntile($1) OVER (  ORDER BY "id" ASC ), first_value("w") OVER (  ORDER BY "id" ASC ), last_value("w") OVER (  ORDER BY "id" ASC ), nth_value("w", $2) OVER (  ORDER BY "id" ASC ), lag("w") OVER (  ORDER BY "id" ASC ), lead("w", $3, $4) OVER (  ORDER BY "id" ASC ) AS "next" FROM "t"

window-json-aggregates.sql: SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("v" ORDER BY "v" ASC) OVER ( PARTITION BY "k" ), JSON_OBJECTAGG("k" : "v") OVER "w" AS "pairs" FROM "t" WINDOW "w" AS (  ORDER BY "k" ASC )

ranges.sql: SELECT * FROM "booking" WHERE "during" @> CAST($1::timestamptz AS timestamptz) AND ("during" && $2) AND "seats" <@ $3 AND ("spans" && $4) AND "tags" @> $5 AND ("weights" && CAST($6::text AS app.floatrange))
